title: Power's Omari Hardwick Says Starz Reached Out About Him Making A Return [Watch]
htmlContent:
Power series, recently opened up about the possibility of returning to the Power Universe in a future project. Hardwick revealed that he had been approached by the producers of the show in the last year and a half about reprising his role, but his demands weren't met once it got back to Starz.

In an interview, Hardwick stated that he would only consider returning to the Power Universe if the project was the perfect fit for him. He said that he had a lot of respect for the creators and the work they had done on the series, and that he didn't want to tarnish the legacy of the show by returning for a project that didn't live up to its standards.

While Hardwick's comments suggest that a return to the Power Universe may be a possibility in the future, it seems that the show's creators and Starz will have to meet his high standards if they want him to come back. As one of the most iconic characters in the series, fans would undoubtedly be thrilled to see Hardwick reprise his role as Ghost in a new project, but it remains to be seen whether or not this will happen.
